command.name: security key-manager keystore upgrade-revert show
command.description: This command displays current keystore upgrade/revert status.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the keystore upgrade/revert status of the given Vserver.

parameter.name: keystore-type
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the keystore upgrade/revert status with the given keystore type.

parameter.name: timestamp
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the keystore upgrade/revert status with the given timestamp.

parameter.name: status
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the keystore upgrade/revert status with the given status.

example.p: The following example displays current keystore upgrade/revert status.
example.screen: cluster-1::*>security key-manager keystore upgrade-revert show Vserver Keystore Type Timestamp Status ---------------------- -------------- ----------------------- ---------------- vs1 AKV 10/28/2025 15:33:06 Reverting vserver vs1 completed successfully.
